_comment: Keyboard keys, by pygame key name (pygame.key.key_code). skillBar = one key per action-bar slot, in order; it must have as many keys as skills.json barSlots. Which SKILL sits in each slot is the player's choice (hover a skill in the trees and press the key, or click a slot) and is saved with the character. Default keys follow GDD 12.3 (skills 1–6, potions Q/W); the town portal (E) is not in the GDD yet. An action may list several keys. Shift is both 'compare' (in the inventory) and 'standStill' (click in the world: attack without moving), which never overlap. The options menu (M7-05) will edit this file.
